subject: Request: Platform/Runtime HC + comp band alignment for Q3 hires
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Platform/Runtime HC + comp band alignment for Q3 hires

Team —

Were entering a tight window to lock offers for three roles that are critical to the runtime roadmap and our Q4 throughput targets. Im requesting headcount approval + alignment on comp bands so we can finalize OTEs with recruiting this week. Summary: 

- Req 1: Sr. Infra Engineer (Platform Runtime) — 1 FTE, IC4/IC5 banding preference (urgent).
- Req 2: Senior Runtime Engineer (low-latency kernels) — 1 FTE, IC4.
- Req 3: Mid-level Platform Engineer (autoscaling/ops) — 1 FTE, IC3/IC4 flex.

Why now: both product and ops ask for additional capacity to land the continuous batching and K/V cache rollout by end of Q4. Delaying will push the launch and increase cost per token due to suboptimal batching heuristics.

Attached: HC packet with headcount justification, projected run-rate, and the comp_band_matrix_2025.ods with suggested base/bonus ranges by region. High-level ask: approval to extend offers at the following ranges (total cash, USD, 50th-90th percentiles suggested): 

- Sr. Infra (IC4/IC5): Base 200k-270k, Bonus 15-20%, RSU grant guidance 40-100k 4yr.
- Senior Runtime (IC4): Base 180k-230k, Bonus 12-18%, RSU 30-75k.
- Mid Platform (IC3/IC4): Base 135k-170k, Bonus 8-12%, RSU 15-40k.

Constraints/tradeoffs I want to surface: 
- We have budget for 2 hires at IC4+ comfortably; the third will require either an uplift from a contractor conversion or reprioritization of a non-critical req.
- Market is tight; OrbitCloud recruiter is asking for quick approval — we have a strong candidate for the Senior Runtime role (Taylor Nguyen) whos expecting an offer by 6/20.

Request: confirmation on banding guidance and permission to push the formal offers for the two senior roles (Sr. Infra and Senior Runtime). If we want to include the mid-level req now, say so and Ill reallocate from the SRE bench.

Thanks —
Lukas
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc_packet_Q3_2025.pdf, comp_band_matrix_2025.ods, offer_templates_v3.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Platform/Runtime HC + comp band alignment for Q3 hires

Lukas —

Thanks for the write-up and packet. Quick read-through notes: 

- The ranges for Sr. Infra look reasonable given market comps, but IC5 at the top of that band (270k base) needs VP override unless we tie it to a differentiated executive-impact bucket.
- For the Senior Runtime candidate (Taylor) can you confirm location (will affect banding) and target base they expect?
- For the mid-level role: prefer we convert a contractor (bench id: CON-987) if possible rather than adding net new HC this quarter. If Marcus thinks thats feasible, we can greenlight it without extra budget.

Im +1 on moving the two senior offers forward pending the location detail and a short note from Marcus on contractor conversion feasibility.

-Kim
Head of Talent Partnerships (Interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Platform/Runtime HC + comp band alignment for Q3 hires

Kim / Lukas —

Following up on contractor conversion: CON-987 (S. Patel) is currently on a 6mo contract in edge autoscaling work and is available for conversion, but converting would take two things: (1) an immediate ramp of the bench request and (2) approval to reassign the contract budget to full-time comp. The finance cadence says we can absorb one conversion this quarter if we keep total comp within the existing HC envelope.

On Taylor (Senior Runtime): Taylor is US-based (Bay Area) and has signaled a target cash of ~235k. Given our band guidance, that sits near the upper 60-70th percentile for IC4 in SF. Options: 
- Offer 220k base + 15% bonus + 40k RSU (aggressive but under VP signoff threshold); or
- Offer 230k base + 12% bonus + 55k RSU and ask VP to sign for above-threshold base.

Tradeoff recommendation: extend the first option immediately to hit the timeline and keep room to negotiate RSUs if they counter. Simultaneously, open a short approval thread for the VP to uplift to the second option if they accept and we want to close quickly.

I can reallocate CON-987 into the mid-platform slot if Kim signs off on conversion now. That would leave us with net +2 FTEs vs plan (since wed convert). If we want strictly net-new +3, well need a small budget delta.

-Marcus
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Date: 2025-06-19T13:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Platform/Runtime HC + comp band alignment for Q3 hires

All —

I reviewed the HC packet and the comp matrix. A couple of points from finance and planning: 

- We can approve two net-new FTEs in Q3 without budget modifications if we prioritize the Sr. Infra and Senior Runtime hires and convert CON-987 into the mid-level role. That matches Marcus proposal.
- If Lukas wants all three to be net-new hires (no conversion), wed need to move a tranche from Q4 or request a one-time headcount supplement of roughly $120k run-rate to cover the higher base levels at the SF band.
- RSU grant pools: we have limited headroom; for any above-threshold base (VP uplift) we should prefer RSU top-ups over permanent base increases to manage run-rate.

Decision requested: do you want me to route paperwork to approve (A) two hires + one conversion (fast path) or (B) three net-new hires with a Q3 supplement request (slower)

-Marissa
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference

Lukas / Marcus / Marissa —

Following the thread and Marissas fiscal framing, Talent is authorizing the fast path: 

- Approved to extend offers for: Sr. Infra (IC4 target, permission to use the higher equity option to close if needed) and Senior Runtime (IC4) 
- For Taylor Nguyen (Senior Runtime): extend 220k base + 15% bonus + 40k RSU today. If candidate counters, Marcus / Lukas, escalate to VP for the uplift to 230k base + 12% bonus + 55k RSU.
- Approved to convert contractor CON-987 into the Mid Platform role (IC3/IC4) and reassign budget accordingly. Marissa will route the conversion paperwork; recruiting to prepare offer packet using offer_templates_v3.docx.
